known_findings.summary: The tips categorical day levels contain "Their" instead of "Thur". A real Thur source value is converted to NaN during post-processing.
get_file_data calls get_file_from_zip for .zip inputs but discards the returned member and then reopens the archive container. load_file_from_path on a ZIP CSV fails.
upload_handler(return_file=False) calls clean_sql(query) even when query is the documented default None; ordinary CSV uploads therefore return None through the broad exception handler.
upload_handler(return_file=True, clean_tmp=True) returns tmp_path and then deletes it in finally, yielding a path that does not exist.
load_data/load_data_meta on .db/.sqlite/.duckdb with the documented query=None default call clean_sql(None), so the default SELECT 1 behavior is unreachable.
Executable recipe/doc examples use python -m scikitplot.datasets._data_export.py or _autoscout24_tasks.py; trailing .py is not an importable module name.
The focused datasets suite does not import or exercise _data_loader.py, leaving archive/upload/database dispatch regressions invisible to the nominal green suite.
